We look inside your sewer line before anyone digs.

HD camera inspection to diagnose sewer line problems accurately. You watch the picture with us, and you get a written report of what we saw.

Call (844) 212-9186

When an inspection is worth it

Buying a house? A standard home inspection often doesn't include the sewer line. It's buried, and it's expensive to find out later.

  • The same drain keeps clogging
  • Slow drains in more than one room
  • A sewer smell inside or out in the yard
  • A wet or sunken patch over the sewer line
  • You're buying a house with an older sewer line
  • You're about to plant trees or redo the yard

What the camera can show us

Pick one to see what it looks like down there, what it means, and what usually happens next.

What it looks like
Thin hairs or thick ropes pushing in through the joints and across the pipe.
What it means
Roots found a small gap and moved in. They catch paper and grease, which is why the clog keeps coming back.
What usually happens next
Usually jetting or root cutting to clear it. If a joint is open, we talk about repairing or lining that section.

Your visit, start to finish

  1. 1

    We find your cleanout

    That's the capped pipe the camera goes in through. We'll help you locate it if you aren't sure where it is.

  2. 2

    The camera goes in

    A small HD camera on a flexible cable travels down the line.

  3. 3

    You watch with us

    We show you the picture as we go, and explain what you're looking at.

  4. 4

    We note what we find

    Problems get noted with where they are in the line, so repairs can be planned.

  5. 5

    You get a written report

    It says what's wrong, what isn't, and what we'd do about it.

Things people ask us

How long does it take?

Often around an hour. Long or tricky lines can take longer.

Do you dig anything up?

No. The camera goes in through the cleanout. If your house doesn't have one, we'll explain the other ways in before we start.

What if you find nothing wrong?

Then you've got that in writing. That's useful too, especially if you're buying the house.

Not sure what's wrong?

Let's take a look inside.

Call us and tell us what you've noticed. We'll set up a time.
